title: Regression: Environment Variables tool crashes immediately in elevated mode (PowerToys 0.100.1–0.100.2, Windows 11 25H2)
author: ioritree

status.label: Superseded by newer linked fix
status.detail: The original 0.100.x Environment Variables crash persists in 0.101 for some users but is now covered by #49880 and PR #50027.

next_action.label: Monitor linked fix
next_action.reason: Avoid duplicate design work; track the active CJK/title-bar fix in PR #50027.

judgment.rationale: The report is related to a genuine crash that was not fully fixed by #49069 for CJK cases, but newer issue #49880 and PR #50027 now carry the active fix path.
evidence: Original report covers 0.100.1-0.100.2 elevated Environment Variables crashes with Microsoft.UI.Windowing.dll, e0464645, offset 0x4bc71.
Maintainer comment said #49069 should fix it in 0.101.
Latest issue comment reports the same triggering route and fault offset still present in prerelease 0.101.2242.
Newer issue #49880 contains fuller 0.101 diagnostics and is linked to active PR #50027.
judgment.recommended_action: Treat as superseded/handled by #49880 and PR #50027; no separate action.

issue_context.summary: Environment Variables elevated startup crash was first reported on 0.100.x and later confirmed by a commenter on 0.101.2242; the active investigation and fix have moved to #49880/#50027.
known_information: Multiple users reported Microsoft.UI.Windowing.dll exception e0464645 at offset 0x4bc71.
Disabling Launch as administrator was reported as a workaround for 0.100.2 by one user.
Maintainer identified #49069 as the intended 0.101 fix, but a later comment says the same route and offset still reproduce in 0.101.2242.
PR #50027 is open and addresses the same title-bar startup crash class in Environment Variables and other WinUI windows.
inferences: The 0.101 mention reflects persistence of a real crash after the first fix, not a new independent issue.
The best current tracking item is #49880 because it contains fresh CJK diagnostics and the active linked PR.
issue_context.analysis: Keeping this as handled avoids splitting duplicate Environment Variables crash work across two open issues while preserving the 0.101 regression signal.
initial_investigation: PR #49069 merged in the 0.101 train and guarded empty title-bar startup cases.
PR #50027 is open and seeds fallback titles before title-bar setup for Environment Variables and other WinUI title-bar windows.
Search for Environment Variables plus Microsoft.UI.Windowing.dll found #48971 as the direct earlier report.
